shortcut-group-navigation-rail.description: Keyboard shortcuts for the Pages rail.

shortcut-scope-navigation-rail.description: Available when the current page in the Pages rail has keyboard focus.

shortcut-group-menu.description: Keyboard shortcuts for the menu bar.

shortcut-scope-menu.description: Available when a menu item has keyboard focus.

shortcut-activate-menu-item.description: Choose the menu item that has keyboard focus, as Enter does.

shortcut-open-menu.description: Open the File, Edit, View, Tools or Help menu by the underlined letter in its name.

shortcut-toggle-side-panel.description: Show or hide the current page's side panel while keeping that page open.

shortcut-page-title.description: The keyboard shortcuts available in Motif.

shortcut-group-analyze-texts.description: Keyboard shortcuts for reading and reviewing a Text.

shortcut-group-word-list.description: Keyboard shortcuts for the Word list and Lists rows.

shortcut-group-review-changes.description: Keyboard shortcuts for navigating pending changes.

shortcut-group-diagnostic-tree.description: Keyboard shortcuts for navigating the diagnostic tree.

shortcut-group-morpheme.description: Keyboard shortcuts for a morpheme row.

shortcut-group-window.description: Keyboard shortcuts available throughout the window.

shortcut-group-editing.description: Copy words and selected text, and undo or redo staging actions.

shortcut-scope-analyze-texts.description: Available in the Analyze texts reader.

shortcut-scope-diagnostic-tree.description: Available when the diagnostic tree has keyboard focus.

shortcut-move-between-words.description: Focus the previous or next word in the Text.

shortcut-previous-line.description: Focus the first word on the previous line of the Text.

shortcut-next-line.description: Focus the first word on the next line of the Text.

shortcut-reader-previous-screen.description: Move focus up by the number of lines visible in the reader.

shortcut-reader-next-screen.description: Move focus down by the number of lines visible in the reader.

shortcut-reader-first-line.description: Focus the first line of the Text.

shortcut-reader-last-line.description: Focus the last line of the Text.

shortcut-stage-approve.description: Stage the focused analysis as Approved in Review changes.

shortcut-stage-disapprove.description: Stage the focused analysis as Disapproved in Review changes.

shortcut-stage-unknown.description: Stage the focused analysis as Unknown in Review changes.

shortcut-stage-remove-analysis.description: Stage removing the focused word's FieldWorks analysis in Review changes.

shortcut-stage-incorrect-spelling.description: Stage the focused word's spelling as Incorrect in Review changes.

shortcut-open-add-list.description: Open the list of PanGloss analyses FieldWorks does not hold for the focused word.

shortcut-open-disposition-menu.description: Open the focused word's opinion tiles.

shortcut-previous-change.description: Moves to the previous change in the Review changes list.

shortcut-next-change.description: Marks the change you leave as looked at and moves to the next one.

shortcut-keep-change.description: Marks the current change as looked at and moves to the next one.

shortcut-undo-change.description: Takes the current change out of the Proposal.

shortcut-word-previous-screen.description: Move focus up by the number of rows visible in the list.

shortcut-word-next-screen.description: Move focus down by the number of rows visible in the list.

shortcut-previous-diagnostic-item.description: Focus the preceding item in the diagnostic tree.

shortcut-next-diagnostic-item.description: Focus the following item in the diagnostic tree.

shortcut-focus-word-search.description: Move keyboard focus to the current page's word search.

shortcut-open-inspector.description: Open the focused morpheme in the Inspector.

shortcut-open-help.description: Show Help for the current page.

shortcut-step-back.description: Return to the preceding Inspector level.

shortcut-open-settings.description: Open Settings at its last group.

shortcut-reset-zoom.description: Return display zoom to its default.

shortcut-copy.description: Copy selected text or the focused word as plain text.

shortcut-undo.description: Undo the last staging action in this window session.

shortcut-redo.description: Redo the last staging action you undid.

shortcut-close-settings.description: Return to the previous page when no field is handling Escape.

shortcut-save-parsing-limits.description: Apply the parsing limits you entered.

shortcut-cancel-parsing-limit-edit.description: Restore the saved parsing limits while editing them.

shortcut-move-between-theme-choices.description: Move focus among Light, Dark and System.

shortcut-focus-close-settings.description: Move focus from the Settings sections to Back.

shortcut-focus-settings-groups.description: Move focus from Back to the Settings groups.

shortcut-group-tables.description: Navigation and actions in grouped tables.

shortcut-table-next-action.description: Focus the next row or group action.

shortcut-table-previous-action.description: Focus the previous row or group action.

shortcut-table-open-actions.description: Open the actions menu for the selected row.
